body:
Ted Kaczynski (Well known as the Unabomber of FC (Freedom Club)) wrote one day:-
TK>Industrial Society and the Future (Known as the Manifesto with 232 parag's)

TK>Restriction of Freedom is Unavoidable in Industrial Society
(see alt.fan.unabomber)
TK>116. Because of the constant pressure that the system exerts to modify human
TK>behavior, there is a gradual increase in the number of people who cannot or
TK>will not adjust to society's requirements: welfare leeches, youth gang
TK>members, cultists, anti-government rebels, radical environmentalist
TK>saboteurs, dropouts and resistors of various kinds.

These in this list are perhaps the main revolutiomary contingent TK was
assuming would judge technology as the unexceptable ratchit it may be.
But I still think the most shut-down of technology will be done by the Rich
against the poor, before anyone else does a revolutionary tech shut-down.

This will happen when the technology of Rich peoples homes security, is
sufficently advanced to cover the rich with a shield of some kind and
when the Rich feel over taxed enough by us "parasites" feeding on welfare debt.
Imagine the cables being cut that supply electricity and electronic money
to the poor, whilest the Rich surrounded by their shields far off somewhere,
generating their own electricity and with satelite link for electronic money.
The Rich homes shield, I can imagine would be patrols of computer controled
helicopters and possibly Robots, all with far greater sensers and monitoring
ability than any human security system today.
Ready to call up reinforcement when needed, a bit like the Supamax.
They will pay to do it all via satelite maybe via the internet or maybe from
the new moon economy.(Sneaky like the MAI action of the corparations)

[The following suggestions are ideas of mine, be carefull as are untested]
The most constructive thing do do is eat grass crushed by 2 stones and 
boiled.
Or given to a portable box of slugs or worms (that you carry in your
canoe/sley trailer/warm bed box) and cook the worms and slugs in a
split twig over a small fire or charcoal glow.
Remember we got in this mess by splitting things such as the atom
now its time to learn how to split the bounty of nature again, instead of
becoming a jelly fish couch potato as I seem to be.
Start or join your local family survivalist club is the most constuctive real
activity imaginable for me. Tom Tomorrow should be renamed Tum Tomorrow.

Where would you like automation / Robots to stop?
Where do you think automation / Robots will stop?
